steps.description: Every backend role expects depth in at least one server language and daily fluency with Git. Compare Python, Java, Go, JavaScript and others for backend work, pick one to go deep in, and use Git with a hosted repository.

steps.description: Correctness under concurrent writes and speed under load both come down to transactions, indexes and replication choices. Learn ACID, indexing, replication, sharding and the CAP theorem, and profile slow queries.

steps.description: Every exposed endpoint will be probed, so backend engineers must know the common attacks and defences. Study the OWASP risks, configure TLS, CORS and content security policy, and harden servers.
